messages:
alex: Heads-up — auditor asked for telemetry + RBAC change proof for last rotation window. Need a short plan.

maria: Can you paste the exact auditor ask?

auditor_jones: Hi team — we need: 1) list of RBAC changes (user/service principal) between 2025-02-01 and 2025-02-10, 2) KMS key rotation proof, 3) sample access logs showing a deployed incident triage on 2025-02-05. Redaction ok. Prefer presigned bundle.

alex: thanks. Jamal, can you pull RBAC diffs from terraform state & k8s audit logs? prefer CSV.

jamal: On it. Quick Q: do we include service accounts from non-prod? auditor said prod-only.

auditor_jones: Prod-only please. Non-prod can be omitted. Also include whether emergency access was used.

maria: For KMS rotation: AWS KMS key id arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01 we rotated on 2025-02-03 — have CloudTrail events and a signed manifest. I can generate the manifest.

alex: Good. For logs, we should return three examples: pre-rotation, during rotation, and post-rotation. We'll redact tokens and user ids.

jamal: query I'll run:
```
# k8s audit query
index=prod-audit source=k8s_audit action=RoleBinding | where time >= "2025-02-01" and time <= "2025-02-10"
```
I'll export top 100 events.

infra-bot: deploy-checklist: evidence-bundle size limit 250MB; manifest required; include hash of each file (sha256).

maria: For the manifest I'll include fields: filename, sha256, signed_by, timestamp.

alex: Also include an incident matrix mapping incident id -> artifacts -> logs. e.g., INCIDENT-2025-02-05 -> k8s-pod-oom -> logs: s3://redwood-logs/prod/2025/02/05/oom.log

jamal: Drafting CSVs; ETA 2h. I will exclude non-prod accounts and scrub emails.

auditor_jones: That's perfect. For signature, PM says a GPG-signed manifest is fine. Can you also include a S3 pre-signed url with 7d expiry?

maria: We'll upload to s3://redwood-audit-packages/audit-654321/ and send presigned urls.

sre_oncall: FYI we saw a related alert 2025-02-05 03:21 UTC; SRE confirmed it was a noisy cache invalidation; attaching playbook link: https://wiki.redwood/inci/playbook-cache

alex: Thanks all. Jamal/maria ping me when uploads ready and I'll coordinate delivery to auditor.

jamal: Uploaded CSVs + sample logs, manifest pending signature. presigned urls when signed.

maria: manifest signed and uploaded. presigned link: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-audit-packages/audit-654321/manifest.json?X

auditor_jones: Got it — we'll review and follow up with any clarifying asks. Thanks! :thumbsup:
